general_ui_ux_guidelines: All UI elements MUST be in Portuguese (pt-PT).
All interactive elements and key text/badges MUST include unique 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='connect-button', data-testid='sidebar-nav-consola', data-testid='live-viewer-canvas').
Strict contrast and readability on obsidian dark surface (#0B0D10). Never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays.
Responsive layout with smooth hover and click micro-animations for buttons, tabs, and queue items.
Monospace font (JetBrains Mono) must be used for times, command logs, stat counters, and technical system details.
